theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrbv_cutoff_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (p : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)), StrictMono p.1 → IsOpen N → (∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∈ N) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ G : Euclid P → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G ∧ HasCompactSupport G ∧ tsupport G ⊆ N ∧ (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) → ∑ a, fderiv ℝ (fun x => G x a) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 a) (1 : ℝ)) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y)
